_about: SHELF of German poets of the age before Goethe and after in English before 1931: Klopstock's Odes (Nind, 1848), the Memoirs of Frederick and Margaret Klopstock (Elizabeth Smith, 1810) and Klopstock and his Friends (Miss Benger, 1814); Uhland three ways (Skeat 1864, Sandars 1869, Platt 1848); Körner's life and selections (G. F. Richardson, 1827); and the Life of Gellert (Mrs Douglas, 1805, vols. I and III). Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 108); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check. 'smith' and 'douglas' alone are left out as common surnames.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
